description: This file implements event handling for nl80211 wireless events, including parsing, callback invocation, and registration of event types. It manages various Wi-Fi and regulatory events, supporting dynamic handling via registered callbacks and a lookup table of event IDs.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_mgmtFrame_t
classes.description: Structure representing management frame data, including frame length, frame content, RSSI, and other relevant metadata.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_mgmtFrameTxStatus_t
classes.description: Structure for management frame transmission status, including frame length, frame content, and acknowledgment status.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_wiphyInfo_t
classes.description: Structure containing information about a wireless physical device (wiphy), such as index and name.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_ifaceInfo_t
classes.description: Information about a network interface, including wiphy index and interface index.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_regChangeInfo_t
classes.description: Details about regulatory domain changes including wiphy index and country code.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_radarEvtInfo_t
classes.description: Radar event information including event type, wiphy index, and interface index.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_evtHandlers_cb
classes.description: Callback handler structure containing function pointers for various nl80211 event types, used to register event-specific handlers.

methods.name: const char * wld_nl80211_msgName(uint32_t cmd)
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for a given nl80211 message ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_evtParser_f wld_nl80211_getEventParser(uint32_t eventId)
methods.description: Retrieves the parser function pointer for a specific nl80211 event ID.

methods.name: bool wld_nl80211_hasEventHandler(wld_nl80211_listener_t * pListener,uint32_t eventId)
methods.description: Checks if a specific listener has a handler registered for a given event ID.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_nl80211_updateEventHandlers(wld_nl80211_listener_t * pListener,const wld_nl80211_evtHandlers_cb * const handlers)
methods.description: Updates event handler callbacks for a listener with a provided set of handlers.

methods.name: bool wld_nl80211_getEvtListenerHandlers(wld_nl80211_listener_t * pListener,void ** pData,wld_nl80211_evtHandlers_cb * pHandlers)
methods.description: Retrieves data and handler callbacks associated with a listener.
